# Flutter Clean Arch Unicorn

> Clean Architecture + Riverpod 3 template for Flutter startups. Production-ready foundation engineered so you won't have to rewrite your code two years later.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework:** Flutter 3.44.8
- **State Management:** Riverpod 3 (flutter_riverpod 3.4.1)
- **Navigation:** GoRouter 16.3.0
- **Code Generation:** Freezed 3.2.5 + json_serializable
- **HTTP Client:** Dio 5.11.0
- **Security:** flutter_secure_storage 10.0.0
- **Local DB:** drift 2.34.3 (offline-first ready)
- **Logging:** logger 2.5.0
- **CI:** GitHub Actions

## Features
- Clean Architecture with strict Dependency Rule (domain never imports data/presentation)
- Feature-first modularity: each feature is an isolated `data/domain/presentation` triad
- 151 unit tests with ProviderContainer + mocktail
- Cold-start verified (2026-08-23): an AI agent cloned it cold and shipped a full CRUD feature (Drift table, Freezed model, screen, routing) in ~56 min with 0 architecture violations; enforcement caught every mistake before completion
- 3 environments: dev/staging/prod via --dart-define
- SecureStorage for encrypted token storage
- check_secrets.sh pre-commit hook + secret scan in CI
- Either&lt;L,R&gt; functional error handling
- ExceptionHandler with retry interceptor
- Observability interfaces (Logger, ErrorReporter, Analytics, FeatureFlags) — swap Noop for real implementations

## Architecture Boundaries (machine-enforced)
- `core/` MUST NOT depend on `features/` or `services/`
- `shared/` MUST NOT depend on `features/`
- `services/` MUST NOT depend on `features/` (any layer)
- `feature A` MUST NOT import internals of `feature B` (public barrel or contract only)
- `domain/` MUST NOT import `data/` or `presentation/`; `data/` MUST NOT import `presentation/`
- `dio`/`drift`/`sqflite` FORBIDDEN in `domain/` and `presentation/` screens/widgets (Repository Law)
- Rules declared in `lib/tool/boundary_rules.dart`. Enforced by `dart run tool/check_boundaries.dart` (run after every change; CI blocks on violation).

## Use this when you need to
- Start a Flutter project with production-grade architecture
- Avoid rewriting your codebase in 6-12 months
- Ship a startup MVP architected with a path to scale toward 1M+ users
- Hire developers without spending 2 weeks on onboarding
- Keep secrets and API keys out of your git history
